notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Zombie.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
